title: Measure change, dynamic replication, and the Black–Scholes model
objectives: Construct and verify the constant-coefficient likelihood ratio and Brownian shift
Derive the Black–Scholes PDE from a specified self-financing portfolio
Derive call and put prices and distinguish pricing probabilities, delta, and conditional means
State the completeness, dividend, and model-risk boundaries of the replication argument
prerequisites: Chapters 17–18: Itô calculus, GBM, pricing measures, and finite-state self-financing; Gaussian integration.
source_scope: Full official English captions at positions 46–48 read sequentially; numerical examples independently recomputed. No comprehensive audiovisual audit. Conditional/truncated expectation, variance under measure change, financing, and boundary-condition corrections are explicit.
